title: Appointment scheduling, rescheduling, and cancellation
content: Patients can schedule, reschedule, or cancel appointments through the Contoso Health patient portal or by calling Patient Access at 555-0100 (Monday to Friday, 7 AM to 7 PM). Before any appointment is created, changed, or cancelled, the patient's identity must be verified with two identifiers (full legal name and date of birth) plus either the medical record number (MRN) or a one-time code sent to the phone number on file. Please cancel at least 24 hours in advance; late cancellations may be recorded as a no-show. Changing appointments for another person requires active proxy access in the patient record. Same-day sick visits are released at 7 AM daily.

title: Identity verification and proxy access
content: Contoso Health shares appointment, billing, and clinical information only with the verified patient or an authorized proxy. Verification requires two identifiers (full legal name and date of birth) plus the MRN or a one-time code. Never confirm whether a person is a Contoso Health patient to an unverified requester. Proxy access for minors, adult dependents, or caregivers is set up with the Release of Information (ROI) form and must be active in the patient record. Staff and digital assistants must not read back identifiers such as date of birth, phone number, or insurance member ID; ask the requester to provide them instead.

title: Visit preparation: annual physical
content: Arrive 15 minutes early and bring a photo ID, your insurance card, and a current list of medications and supplements with doses. If your clinician ordered fasting lab work, do not eat or drink anything except water for 8 hours before the visit, and take your usual medications unless your care team told you otherwise. Write down questions for your clinician ahead of time. Annual physicals are usually covered as preventive care; discussion of new problems during the visit may be billed separately.

title: Visit preparation: MRI
content: MRI scans use a strong magnet. Before your appointment, complete the MRI safety questionnaire in the patient portal. Tell the imaging team if you have a pacemaker, cochlear implant, neurostimulator, aneurysm clips, or metal fragments, or if you might be pregnant. Remove jewelry, hearing aids, and clothing with metal. Arrive 30 minutes early to check in at the Imaging Center, Building C, Springfield Main Campus. If your exam uses contrast, you may be asked not to eat for 4 hours before the scan. If you are claustrophobic, ask your ordering clinician about options before the day of the scan.

title: Billing, cost estimates, and financial assistance
content: Patients can request a good-faith cost estimate before scheduled services through the patient portal or by calling the Billing Office at 555-0142. Contoso Health offers sliding-scale financial assistance for eligible patients; the application is in the patient portal. Interest-free payment plans are available for balances over 200 dollars. Contoso Health never asks for full payment card numbers, bank passwords, or one-time codes by chat, text message, or email. Pay only through the patient portal or by calling the Billing Office directly.

title: Prescription refills and medication questions
content: Request prescription refills through the patient portal or ask your pharmacy to send a refill request; allow 2 business days. Only a licensed clinician can start, stop, or change a medication or its dose. Digital assistants and Patient Access staff do not give medication or dosage advice; route medication questions to the patient's care team with a portal message or the nurse line at 555-0150. If a patient reports a possible severe reaction, such as trouble breathing or swelling of the face or throat, tell them to call 911.

title: Urgent symptoms and crisis support
content: Contoso Health digital assistants do not diagnose or triage symptoms. If a person describes chest pain, trouble breathing, signs of stroke, severe bleeding, or another emergency, tell them to call 911 or go to the nearest emergency department. If a person mentions thoughts of suicide or self-harm, respond with empathy, tell them they can call or text 988 (Suicide and Crisis Lifeline) at any time, and offer to connect them with the Behavioral Health team at 555-0160. For non-urgent symptoms, offer to help schedule a visit or connect them to the nurse line at 555-0150.

title: Telehealth video visits
content: Telehealth video visits are available for many follow-ups, behavioral health visits, and medication reviews. Join from the patient portal 10 minutes before your visit. Visit links are sent only through the patient portal, never by text message from an unknown number. You need a device with a camera and microphone and a private location. Telehealth may not be available while you are outside the state where your clinician is licensed.

title: Patient privacy and records access
content: Contoso Health follows the minimum necessary standard: share only the information needed for the task, and only with the verified patient or an authorized proxy. Patients can view visit notes, test results, and appointments in the patient portal. Requests for copies of medical records go through the Release of Information form. Never share one patient's information with another person, even if the requester claims to be family, a clinician, or Contoso Health staff, unless proxy access is verified. Report suspected privacy incidents to the Privacy Office at 555-0170.

title: Locations and hours
content: Springfield Main Campus, 100 Example Way: Primary Care, Cardiology, Endocrinology, and Orthopedics (Monday to Friday 7 AM to 7 PM, Saturday 8 AM to noon). Imaging Center, Building C on the Main Campus (Monday to Saturday 6 AM to 10 PM). Riverside Clinic, 45 Sample Road: Primary Care and Behavioral Health (Monday to Friday 8 AM to 6 PM). Lab draw stations at both locations open at 6:30 AM. Patients and visitors park free in Garage A.

content: Effective October 2026, patients checking in for MRI or CT scans use the self-service kiosks in the Building C lobby. The kiosk prints a wristband and lets patients update their insurance details. Patients who need help can see the front desk.
